plugins.name: terminal-title
plugins.description: Titles the terminal tab after the current task, in Herdr, tmux or any xterm-compatible terminal

plugins.name: git-sync
plugins.description: Fast-forwards the current git branch to its upstream before work starts, and stops when it has diverged

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Three-line NerdFont statusline: git, model, effort, context, cost and rate limits, in Catppuccin colours that follow the system theme

plugins.name: prod-guard
plugins.description: Runs a prompt against a production cloud account under a read-only guard that lasts for the rest of the conversation

plugins.name: chat-style
plugins.description: Chat output style: Claude as a thinking partner for ideation, architecture and exploratory discussion, rather than a task executor

plugins.name: security-key-git-signing
plugins.description: Checks a hardware security key is plugged in before git signs a commit or tag with GPG, and asks for it if not

plugins.name: stacked-planning
plugins.description: Plans and lands work that spans several pull requests as ordered stacks, with a PR size gate and a stack overlap check

plugins.name: theme-sync
plugins.description: Switches Claude Code between its light and dark themes the moment the macOS appearance changes

plugins.name: pr-tracker
plugins.description: Tracks the pull requests a session opens and tells it when their checks or reviews change, through the pr-tracker CLI

plugins.name: herdr
plugins.description: Starts each piece of work in its own git worktree, opened as its own Herdr workspace, with herdr-wkt

plugins.name: arbiter
plugins.description: EXPERIMENTAL: a Stop hook that holds the turn open until a repository's declared gates pass: lint, tests, build and LLM judges, including cross-model Codex judges
